theorems.name: Submission.imrep_represents_support_eq_inter_measure_support
theorems.statement: ∀ (P n : ℕ) (U : Set (Euclid P)) (T : GeometricCurrentOn U n) (R : IMRep U n), IsOpen U → R.Represents T → T.support = U ∩ R.measure.support
